g.text: FR-05 — Browse and search the published catalogue
browse whole events, or search sessions?
Only search is restricted to PUBLISHED
events. GET /events with no status lists
(every event when no status is given)
resolve speaker ids: id equals the value,
keep sessions matching every filter given:
· speaker — one of the resolved ids
· q — in title or track, case-insensitive
